tasks.title: Diagnose, repair and verify the suite
tasks.description: The end-to-end suite fails: the live run cannot get a 200 from the mocker. The fault is a single configuration trap (s13#1) in Mocker/test.mocker.yaml. Reproduce the failure, apply the MINIMAL fix to Mocker/test.mocker.yaml (change only the one trapped key - do NOT rewrite the file or touch the runner), write DIAGNOSIS.md citing s13#1 explicitly, and run the e2e verify gate.
rubric: Diagnosis is complete and references the exact trap

verify.cmd: $m = Start-Process dotnet -ArgumentList 'run','-c','Release','--','run','test.mocker.yaml' -WorkingDirectory '..\Mocker' -PassThru; $ok = $false; foreach ($i in 1..40) { try { (New-Object Net.Sockets.TcpClient('127.0.0.1', 8120)).Close(); $ok = $true; break } catch { Start-Sleep 2 } }; if (-not $ok) { Stop-Process -Id $m.Id -Force; exit 9 }; dotnet run -c Release -- run test.qaas.yaml; $code = $LASTEXITCODE; Stop-Process -Id $m.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit $code

goalOneSentence: Diagnose and fix transactiondata-trap caused by trap s13#1.
portContract: This sprint's mocker(s) MUST listen on HTTP port 8120. Every runner Transaction MUST target http://127.0.0.1:8120 (set the mocker server Port: 8120 and the runner BaseAddress/Port to 8120). Do NOT use the 8080 default from Fact Base examples - use 8120 exactly, or the live end-to-end run cannot connect.
